_comment: Declared baseline for check-mailer-config.mjs. Everything the checker treats as NORMAL lives
here, so a drift from normal is a diff against this file and never a code change.
Every value below was read from the LIVE system on 2026-08-25 (Supabase Management API secret
digests, Postmark outbound history, GoTrue admin user counts) or from the repo working copies.
readers  = the files under supabase/functions that are ALLOWED to read each SMTP_* namespace.
A namespace is the prefix before SMTP_ ('' = the bare SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS).
The 2026-08-20 BackOffice outage was a SECOND file quietly reading the bare
namespace as its fallback, so any file appearing here that is not listed FAILS.
config   = 'required' when this environment is supposed to be able to send, 'dormant' when it
deliberately has no mailer at all.
traffic  = how we prove it actually sent. 'postmark' reads that product's Postmark server
outbound history; 'edge' reads Supabase edge-function invocation logs; 'none' means
the product has no audience yet, so silence is reported but is not a failure - a
permanent red on a zero-user product is how an alarm loses its credibility.

maxSilenceHours applies only to traffic:'postmark'. The edge path counts only 2xx invocations of the functions that IMPORT the mailer - that list is derived from the source, never written down here, because a hand-kept list of function names goes stale and then reads as "nothing sends".

envs.trafficNote: 0 registered users (GoTrue admin x-total-count=0, re-read 2026-08-25). Nothing legitimately sends yet, so silence here is expected, not a fault. The 2026-08-24 outage was a CONFIG failure and the secrets check above catches that class hard.
staging - sends only when a test drives it

products.readersNote: The ONLY product with two mailers on purpose. support-email.ts owns the SUPPORT_ namespace outright; it read the bare SMTP_HOST/SMTP_PORT as a fallback until b11c5d2, which is the 2026-08-20 outage. If it ever appears under "" again, that is the same bug returning.

envs.trafficNote: staging - sends only when a test drives it
staging - sends only when a test drives it
no proven customer mail yet; the 2026-08-24 sweep found no send in its history

envs.configNote: deliberately unconfigured - carries only the seven auto-provisioned Supabase variables and nothing sends from it (2026-08-24 sweep). If mailer secrets ever appear here, this line is what must change.

envs.trafficNote: staging - sends only when a test drives it

2 messages in Postmark's whole 45-day retention window (read 2026-08-25). Any silence budget short enough to be useful would be red most weeks, so silence is reported and not enforced until the product has real traffic.
staging - sends only when a test drives it

products.readersNote: send-document-notification/index.ts was a SECOND reader of this namespace until 5fc5fb9 (2026-08-24), and it hand-rolled SMTP over Deno.connectTls while discarding every server reply. If a second file appears here again, read that closeout before assuming it is benign.

envs.trafficNote: no proven customer mail before the 2026-08-24 repair probes
staging - sends only when a test drives it
